newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India issues second Feb diesel purchase tender.
newsitem.headline: India issues second Feb diesel purchase tender.

text.p: State-owned India Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a tender to purchase more 1.0 percent sulphur high speed diesel for delivery to Kandla, west coast India for February, industry sources said on Thursday.
The tender seeks one cargo each of 40,000-45,000 tonnes for delivery on February 1-7 and February 8-15.
The tender closes on January 9 and offers are valid to January 11.
IOC had earlier this week bought an unexpectedly large volume of 720,000 tonnes of diesel for delivery in February.
For its January requirement, IOC had also issued a suplementary tender to purchase an additional 90,000 tonnes of 1.0 percent diesel on top of an earlier purchase of 255,000-tonnes.
